value.title: ConversionLab – CRO for B2B SaaS companies
value.description: ConversionLab helps B2B SaaS companies convert more at every stage of the funnel – from landing page to renewal. One specialist, no juniors, data-driven results.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Start with a free strategy session. I'll look at your funnel, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and map out what an engagement would look like – no obligation.
Most CRO agencies stop at the first click. I don't. 
I help Nordic B2B SaaS companies turn traffic into customers, and customers into revenue that keeps growing.
Free · 30 minutes · No commitment
Hi there! I'm Finge,
founder of ConversionLab
12+ years of experience 
Conversion Rates
+36% vs last 6 mths
Cost per Lead
-24% vs last 6 mths
No extra ad spend required. Higher conversion rates mean your existing budget goes further – and every improvement stacks on the one before it.
Each winning test raises the baseline for the next. Six months in, you're testing from a much stronger position than when you began.
No juniors, no account managers, no handoffs. The person who writes the hypothesis is the person who runs the test – and the one you can actually talk to.
ConversionLab played a key role in accelerating Campaign Monitor's growth by optimizing our landing pages for maximum performance. We increased conversion rates by 260% in the first 6 months and 1187% cumulatively across the full engagement, and saw a 64% reduction in customer acquisition cost. We are very happy with the results!
“
33
Based on solid hypothesis and across several pages.
1187%
The total uplift combined at an average 36% uplift per test.
64%
Increased conversion rates means reduced customer acquisition cost.
Shamita Jayakumar
Senior Marketing Manager
+1187%
Cumulative CVR uplift – Campaign Monitor
-64%
Reduction in customer acquisition cost – Campaign Monitor
+116%
Uplift from clarity and distraction removal – BetterWorld
The average B2B SaaS company loses 40–60% of trial signups before they ever reach the aha moment. Most CRO agencies only optimize the ad-to-signup step and stop there. ConversionLab tests its way through the full journey – landing page, trial, activation, pricing – with the same systematic discipline at every stage.
Landing pages, trial signups, demo requests. Every element tested until it earns its place.
ENTRY POINT
Design Project – one landing page in 5 business days. Fixed price, clear brief, ready to launch.
GROWTH PATH
CRO retainer – ongoing A/B testing that builds on itself. Every winning test raises the baseline for the next.
ACQUISITION
RETENTION
Onboarding flows, trial-to-paid conversion, pricing page optimization. Fix the leaks before they cost you MRR.
ENTRY POINT
Retention project – implement the highest-priority changes we identify. Defined scope, fixed price.
GROWTH PATH
Ongoing retention optimization – systematic testing at onboarding, activation, and renewal.

I start where your paid traffic lands. Then I follow the user through to renewal. Same discipline, same specialist – applied to every step of the funnel your Growth team is already accountable for.
Campaign Monitor partnered with ConversionLab to turn more paid traffic into paying customers – without increasing ad spend. Over the engagement, 33 A/B tests were run across 10 landing pages.
ConversionLab has a knack for drawing out new and inventive tactics from tried-and-true methods that deliver real results. Their reputation for optimizing is only matched by their friendliness, and that's incredibly rare.
JESSICA BURNHAM
Advocacy & Community Manager
Unbounce
ConversionLab helped Nintex implement a conversion optimization strategy to grow our lead generation. They designed and optimized high-performing landing pages where conversion rates skyrocketed and cost per lead dropped to record lows!
MENILIK HENRY DYER
Marketing Manager
Nintex & Promapp Solutions
ConversionLab is a one-person operation – and that's a deliberate choice, not a limitation. When you work with ConversionLab, you work directly with Finge Holden. Every brief, every hypothesis, every A/B test. No juniors interpreting your strategy. No account managers as the go-between. No work being passed down the chain.
Why does this matter?
At a traditional agency, the senior person who sold you the engagement rarely runs it. At ConversionLab, the person you spoke to in the strategy session is the same person analyzing your heatmaps on a Tuesday morning and writing the copy variant on Wednesday. That continuity – knowing your business, your users, your previous test results – is what makes the work faster and sharper over time.
12+ years of conversion optimization and paid acquisition experience for B2B SaaS companies, applied directly to your funnel. No dilution.
High-converting pages and tight onboarding flows only deliver their full value if the underlying system can track, route, and follow up on every lead. HubSpot optimization sits underneath both Acquisition and Retention – connecting paid traffic, lead capture, and CRM so nothing falls through the gaps.
It's not a headline service. It's what makes everything else
